messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error with speciesCol in surveyReport
parts:
Hi Jen, 
there is an unnecessary comma at the end of your command, at the end of this line:

 makezip = TRUE,

R expects another argument after the comma, hence the error message.
Cheers,
Jürgen
